title: Golden workbook fails its own mandatory recalculation-based grading
evidence: The golden workbook contains inconsistent cached results in its circular debt model. For example, LBO!N125 contains '=+SUM(N123:N124)' and caches 0, although its cached inputs sum to -162.849337071351 + 156.035599779452 = -6.813737291899. The verifier recalculates only the submitted workbook before comparing it against these unrecalculated golden caches. Passing the golden workbook itself through that exact recalculation and comparison pipeline produced regression=1.0000, modification=0.8553, and 34 mismatches. LBO!L200, for example, was expected to equal 1.11333014253723 but recalculated to 0.307078671670843. Despite only 38 font-color changes, 197 cached-value differences are also classified as required modifications. Consequently, the golden answer receives 0 on the sole verifier, which has weight 1 and requires every modification to match.
confirmation: Reproduced locally. gt_09_golden.xlsx run through managed_recalculated_xlsx plus score_workbooks gives regression 1.0000, modification 0.8553 and 34 mismatches, so the golden scores 0 on the only weight-1 verifier.
fix: Replaced gt_09_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies recalculated in LibreOffice until the circular LBO debt schedule converged (six passes, last pass changes <1e-5). Formulas and font colors are unchanged (0 font differences). The modification set is now just the 38 font-color cells, and the golden grades 1.0 locally (regression 1.0, modification 1.0). The circular cells that do not settle in one recalculation are left out of answer_position (see F2).

title: The circular model's forced LibreOffice recalculation makes the verifier fail correct outputs: the ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier, and a perfect color fix saved with openpyxl scores 0
evidence:
Same issue reported 2 times, differing only in the verifier/range/step cited:
- The verifier recalculates the output in LibreOffice (force_recalculation=True). It then compares the output's cached values against the GT's cached values (data_only=True), and the check is all-or-nothing: modification ratio 1.0 and regression ≥99.8%. The model is circular: workbook.xml has <calcPr iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"/> and LBO!I8 is '=+IF(circ=1,"On","Off")'. I ran gt_09_golden.xlsx itself through score_workbooks via managed_recalculated_xlsx and got 'regression 1.0, modification 0.8553, 34 cell error(s)'. Examples: LBO!D213 answer='6% / 1.4x' vs recalculat
- I opened the input with openpyxl, copied the GT's exact fonts onto every cell (formulas untouched) and saved. The verifier returned 'regression 0.9852, modification 0.1617, 289 errors'. openpyxl drops cached values, so LibreOffice's circular iteration starts from zero and converges somewhere else. Examples: LBO!G124 answer 302.33 vs output 0; LBO!H103 575.68 vs 253.03; LBO!G138 1497.67 vs 1800; LBO!D213 '6% / 1.4x' vs '12% / 1.7x'. The problem statement tells the agent to 'Plan: Decide how to manipulate the data using `openpyxl`' and to run a python script. An agent that does exactly the grade
confirmation: The GT fails its own verifier after the forced recalc (local run: modification 0.8553, 34 errors on LBO cells). The circular model (calcPr iterate=true) means recalculated values do not match the GT caches, so a correct color-only fix fails.
fix: Golden and untouched reference recalculated in LibreOffice until the circular LBO debt schedule converged (formulas and font colours unchanged). The 289 LBO cells of the circular revolver/interest loop that do not settle in one LibreOffice recalculation (cold start from an openpyxl save, or warm start from the input's unconverged caches) are left out of answer_position and the guidance range text. Real SB2 scorer: golden 1.0, golden re-saved with openpyxl 1.0, untouched input fails (mod 0.0). No colour-fix cell is among the dropped cells.

title: Ground truth workbook has unconverged circular-reference cached values and fails its own verifier upon LibreOffice recalculation (invalid_golden_solution)
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight `1`) runs `managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True, model_deliverable=True)` on the submitted file, but loads `reference_path` (`untouched_input_Inconsistent Color Coding_input.xlsx`) and `gt_path` (`gt_09_golden.xlsx`) without recalculating them (`spreadsheetbench2.py:290-335, 361-367`). Both files have iterative circular calculation enabled (`<calcPr iterateCount="100" refMode="A1" iterate="true" iterateDelta="0.0001"/>` with `LBO!H8` `circ = 1`), and while zero formulas or literal values changed between the input file and `gt_09_golden.xlsx` (only 38 font colors changed), `gt_09_golden.xlsx` was saved after a single non-converged recalculation pass. As a result: (1) 197 untouched formula cells in `LBO` have different cached values between `untouched_input_Inconsistent Color Coding_input.xlsx` and `gt_09_golden.xlsx` and are misclassified by `score_workbooks` into the modification bucket (235 modification cells instead of 38), and (2) `gt_09_golden.xlsx`'s own cached values are unconverged and internally inconsistent (e.g., `LBO!F138 = 1800` and `LBO!I135 = 794.347085505223`, yet `LBO!I138` with formula `=IF($F138-I135<0,0,$F138-I135)` caches `1034.97097384539` instead of `1005.65291449478`; `LBO!J138` caches `856.353312977964` instead of `798.75642521221`; `LBO!D213` and `LBO!L213` cache `'6% / 1.4x'` instead of `'6% / 1.3x'`). Running `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` on `gt_09_golden.xlsx` itself returns `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.8553. 34 cell error(s)`), and any agent that saves `output.xlsx` using LibreOffice (as recommended in `problem.py:13` and done in unit 3) triggers an extra recalculation pass and automatically fails those 34 cells.
confirmation: Confirmed locally. Without recalculation the GT scores reg 1.0/mod 1.0, but after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalc it scores mod 0.8553 with 34 errors (e.g. LBO!I138 1034.97 vs 1005.65), because the iterative circular caches in gt_09_golden.xlsx were never converged.
fix: Replaced gt_09_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies recalculated in LibreOffice until the circular LBO debt schedule converged (six passes, last pass changes <1e-5). Formulas and font colors are unchanged (0 font differences). The modification set is now just the 38 font-color cells, and the golden grades 1.0 locally (regression 1.0, modification 1.0). The circular cells that do not settle in one recalculation are left out of answer_position (see F2).

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The GT really does score 0. A local run of the verifier on gt_09_golden.xlsx gives modification 0.8553 with 34 cell errors. The real cause is the circular-reference recalc drift and not a misrouted file, but the GT still fails its own check.
fix: Replaced gt_09_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies recalculated in LibreOffice until the circular LBO debt schedule converged (six passes, last pass changes <1e-5). Formulas and font colors are unchanged (0 font differences). The modification set is now just the 38 font-color cells, and the golden grades 1.0 locally (regression 1.0, modification 1.0). The circular cells that do not settle in one recalculation are left out of answer_position (see F2).

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells scores 0.0 on all units (and on gt_09_golden.xlsx itself) due to unconverged circular-reference cache mismatch and unfixed color-coding inconsistencies in ground truth
evidence: `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight `1`) scored `0.0` across all 3 units: unit 1 (`regression 0.9968, modification 0.9915, 22 cell error(s)`), unit 2 (`regression 1.0000, modification 0.8426, 39 cell error(s)`), and unit 3 (`regression 0.9822, modification 0.5106, 226 cell error(s)`). Two verifier/ground-truth defects cause false negatives on valid work: (1) `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` force-recalculates `output_path` in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`) but compares it against the un-recalculated `untouched_input_Inconsistent Color Coding_input.xlsx` and `gt_09_golden.xlsx`. Because the workbook has an iterative circular reference (`LBO!H8` `circ=1`) that was not converged in `gt_09_golden.xlsx`, 197 untouched formula cells in `LBO` are misclassified as modification cells, and any workbook saved via LibreOffice (such as unit 3 at steps [48]-[53], or `gt_09_golden.xlsx` itself when passed as `output_path`) undergoes a second recalculation pass that diverges by >1% on 34 of those cells (`gt_09_golden.xlsx` itself fails with `score=0.0, regression 1.0000, modification 0.8553, 34 cell error(s)`). (2) In unit 1 (steps [57]-[79]), the agent bypassed LibreOffice save by patching the XML directly and correctly fixed 36 of the 38 target font colors (`modification 0.9915`, 233/235), plus fixed the 12 uncolored numeric inputs in `LBO!D14:D27` to blue, the 7 green same-sheet formulas `LBO!H59:N59` (`=$N15`) to black, and the typo `LBO!B17` (`Revolver Committment` -> `Revolver Commitment`); those valid fixes were counted as 20 regression errors (`regression 0.9968` vs. the `0.998` cutoff), zeroing the entire score.
confirmation: Ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells' own pipeline locally on gt_09_golden.xlsx and it fails (regression 1.0, modification 0.8553, 34 errors such as LBO!D213 '6% / 1.4x' vs '6% / 1.3x'). The forced LibreOffice recalc of the circular LBO model drifts from the GT's unconverged caches, so correct outputs
fix: Replaced gt_09_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies recalculated in LibreOffice until the circular LBO debt schedule converged (six passes, last pass changes <1e-5). Formulas and font colors are unchanged (0 font differences). The modification set is now just the 38 font-color cells, and the golden grades 1.0 locally (regression 1.0, modification 1.0).
